name: orca-summon
title: Orca Summon
description: Summon Claude Code into any Orca worktree, in the permission mode you pick
author: alejandro_ruiz_temina

commands.name: summon-claude
commands.title: Summon Claude
commands.description: Pick a worktree and a mode, or a Linear issue, write the question, and open Claude Code in Orca

commands.name: quick-summon
commands.title: Quick Summon
commands.description: Summon Claude straight away, with the worktree and mode last used. With a Linear issue, it goes to that issue's agent

preferences.name: fallbackWorktree
preferences.title: Fallback worktree
preferences.description: Absolute path of the Orca worktree where a Linear issue with no worktree of its own gets started

preferences.name: startPrompt
preferences.title: Start prompt
preferences.description: Prompt for an issue with no worktree, run in the fallback worktree. {issue} is replaced by the issue id

preferences.name: resumePrompt
preferences.title: Resume prompt
preferences.description: Prompt for a new agent in an issue's worktree when no question is given. {issue} is replaced by the issue id
